title: Crash when settings come from environment variables
issue:
beacon 1.4 won't start in Docker: TypeError in config.py

After upgrading from 1.3.2 to 1.4.0 our container exits immediately. I think the INI parsing broke in 1.4, because the traceback is in config.py and the only thing in our image that touches config is `beacon.ini`.

docker-compose.yml:

```yaml
services:
  status:
    image: ourorg/status:latest
    command: python -m beacon check --config /etc/beacon.ini
    environment:
      BEACON_PORT: "9000"
      BEACON_DEBUG: "false"
```

/etc/beacon.ini:

```ini
[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
log_level = warning
```

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/runpy.py", line 198, in _run_module_as_main
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/beacon/__main__.py", line 25, in <module>
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/beacon/__main__.py", line 15, in main
    config = load_config(args.config)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/beacon/config.py", line 65, in load_config
    validate(config)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/beacon/config.py", line 40, in validate
    if not 1 <= config["port"] <= 65535:
TypeError: '<=' not supported between instances of 'int' and 'str'
```

Same image with 1.3.2 works fine. Maybe configparser changed in Python 3.12?
